page.notes: Column order: the left column runs from the first line to "absoluendis à purga-"; the right column follows from "torio animabus detestata 369" to "Pata-". Some entries continue across the column break (e.g. "Papiensis... priuatus", "Parisiensis schola ponitificis", "in Parisiensi academia"). The left and right lines of the same row are printed side by side and are listed here in column order. Possible misreadings: "ium ciuile legi uetitum", "passerculi nocem interpretatum magus" (the printed line has the words "pretatum magus" on the right at the foot, with "passerculi nocem inter-" above), and the line "Papiensis tantum mone tae usus Longobardis" (the word "mone" could be "monetae"). The page numbers "7677" and "542 543" are printed without a separator. Abbreviated words are as printed; the text at the foot is cut off at "Pata-".
